title: Christoph Raethke (Berlin Startup Academy founder) — critical European take: 'this one seems to be uniquely American'
summary: Christoph Raethke — angel investor, author, founder of Berlin Startup Academy — publishes a contrarian read on the first chapters of Incorruptible, arguing that the book's framing of unrestrained profit optimization assumes an American context with no equivalent of Bismarck's social legislation, Mittelstand culture, or East Asian corporate community structures.
blockquote: this one seems to be uniquely American.
attribution_title: Angel in Residence; investor, author, mentor; founder of Berlin Startup Academy
